anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, shallow convexity with a large radius of curvature across the dorsal-anterior cranial surface.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust terminal extension; visible portion exhibits a low length-to-thickness ratio from the current perspective.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse inflection point visible at the junction where the melon slope transitions to the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, light-colored linear striations oriented diagonally across the mid-lateral body segment.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlights along the dorsal ridge; mottled pigmentation transition between the dark dorsal and lighter lateral regions.
